mechanism: Torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion (potassium, magnesium) may increase QT prolongation risk, and bictegravir has potential for cardiac conduction effects; additionally, bictegravir is a substrate of CYP3A4 and P-gp, and torsemide may indirectly affect renal clearance through volume/electrolyte changes.
action: Monitor electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium) regularly, assess QTc interval baseline and periodically, ensure adequate hydration, and consider potassium-sparing agent or supplementation if hypokalemia develops.
